report.scope: Original failed full-wire 32:1 native capture. No new simulation, model edit, phase fit, original-bit substitution or threshold change. Reproduce all original gates before localizing failed stages and HBT headroom.

original_signal_gate.method: All original source bits at unchanged 0.3/0.5/0.7 UI; 100mV limit. No fitted latency, resampling phase adjustment, or actual-input-derived oracle.

capture.method: Memory-mapped full binary raw; every original vector retained; no interpolation/decimation

parts.meaning: Concatenate strictly in index order; verify every part and combined SHA256 before extracting. No original waveform samples removed.
